pages.text: $(l)Two paths, one key$()$(br)$(thing)Ars Nouveau$(): spells, magebloom and source, ending at the $(item)Enchanting Apparatus$(). $(thing)Astral Sorcery$(): starlight, crystals and the night sky. Either one forges the $(item)Twilight Key$().
Magebloom doesn't grow wild. Break the leaves of $(thing)archwood trees$() (tall and brightly coloured) for seeds. Plant many: it grows slowly.
The Astral path works at night under an open sky. Start with the $(item)Astral Tome$(): aquamarine from sand and riverbeds, and a book.

$(l)Into the Twilight$()$(br)Dig a 2x2 pool of water, ring it with flowers or grass, and throw the key in. Step through to open Age III.$(br2)Iron tools, backpacks, drawers and $(thing)NeoVitae$() (blood magic) open this age too.
